decision.observation: Clear 2x view of the latched gate. The right post carries the vertical latch bolt with an upper handle at ~(0.60, 0.47) beside the goose's beak (~0.578, 0.53), and a lower curved handle at ~(0.60, 0.64). The bowl sits beyond the gate slats; no groundskeeper visible on the garden path.
decision.hypothesis: Grab = left mouse OR Z per controls. Holding Z (grab) while a left press occurs on the adjacent latch handle may bind the grip in a way plain presses haven't; then a follow-up walk click would drag the latch open.
decision.memory: Compound key variant (Z held + left press) untested on this latch.
